Definition
[bivectors as skew-symmetric maps]

Source: petersen:page-0100 ↗ def:pet-ch3-bivector-inner-product

Identify a decomposable bivector with the skew-adjoint map \[ (x\wedge y)(v)=g(x,v)y-g(y,v)x, \] which satisfies $g(x\wedge y,v\wedge w)=g(x,v)g(y,w)-g(x,w)g(y,v)=g((x\wedge y)(v),w)$.
